finding.title: Qualify default-filter search behavior
finding.description: On an initial Inbox URL without explicit filter/member parameters, the list defaults to Open/current user but Search only reads filter/member/label from the browser URL. Typing immediately can therefore search beyond the visually selected personal list. The blanket sentence that active filters always apply is overbroad for this initial state.
finding.suggestion: Tell readers to explicitly choose the desired state from Show filters before typing, even if that state appears selected already; then refer to the applied filters. Keep exact F1 query/state/member/label in capture provenance.
finding.limit: This is source-backed pre-existing product behavior, not introduced by these article edits. No application fix or external write requested.
finding.resolution: Search opening explicitly requires choosing the desired state via Show filters > Actions even if it appears selected, then checking teammate/label and entering the query. Constraint sentence is limited to filters applied through Show filters. Combined procedure repeats the explicit state selection.
